environments.dev: A development environment will be provisioned for active coding and unit testing, mirroring production services where feasible.
environments.test: A dedicated test environment will be used for integration, system, and user acceptance testing before production deployment.
environments.prod: The production environment will host the live customer portal, configured for high availability and performance.

deployment_runtime.validation_reason: Deployment strategy is inferred from platform choice and assumed volumes (ASM_01).
deployment_runtime.text: The customer portal frontend (ARC_01) will be deployed on Azure Static Web Apps, providing global distribution and efficient content delivery. The backend APIs (ARC_02) will run on Azure App Service, offering a managed platform for scalable application hosting. Database services (ARC_03) will utilize Azure SQL Database, and identity management (ARC_04) will be handled by Microsoft Entra External ID. Integration components (EXT_TMS, EXT_FINANCE, EXT_PAYMENT) will leverage Azure API Management, while secrets are managed in Azure Key Vault (ARC_07).

availability_scalability.validation_reason: Availability and scalability are designed based on assumed mid-market volumes (ASM_01).
availability_scalability.text: The solution is designed for high availability and scalability to support assumed mid-market volumes (ASM_01). Azure Static Web Apps (ARC_01) inherently provides global distribution and high availability. Azure App Service (ARC_02) will be configured with auto-scaling rules to handle fluctuating loads, while Azure SQL Database (ARC_03) offers built-in high availability and read replicas for scalability. Azure API Management (ARC_05, EXT_TMS, EXT_FINANCE, EXT_PAYMENT) and Azure Web Application Firewall (ARC_08) also provide scalable and resilient services.

backup_dr.validation_reason: Backup and DR strategy is inferred from the importance of data for assumed volumes (ASM_01).
backup_dr.text: Azure SQL Database (ARC_03) includes automated backups and point-in-time restore capabilities. Geo-redundant storage will be configured for critical data to ensure disaster recovery capabilities. Application code and configurations will be managed in version control and deployed via CI/CD pipelines, allowing for rapid recovery.

observability.validation_reason: Observability requirements are inferred from the need to monitor performance and usage for assumed volumes (ASM_01).
observability.text: Azure Monitor (ARC_06) will be used to collect logs, metrics, and traces from all Azure components (ARC_01, ARC_02, ARC_03, ARC_05, EXT_TMS, EXT_FINANCE, EXT_PAYMENT). Application Insights, part of Azure Monitor, will provide application performance monitoring for the portal backend. Dashboards and alerts will be configured to proactively identify and respond to operational issues.

security_controls.validation_reason: Security controls are based on the pending assumption of standard web security practices (ASM_05).
security_controls.text: Security controls will adhere to standard web security practices (ASM_05). Customer authentication will be managed by Microsoft Entra External ID (ARC_04) with MFA. Azure Web Application Firewall (ARC_08) will protect against common web attacks. Secrets and keys will be stored in Azure Key Vault (ARC_07). Network segmentation and private endpoints will be implemented where appropriate to secure communication between components (ARC_02, ARC_05, EXT_TMS, EXT_FINANCE, EXT_PAYMENT).
